observations.title: Etna volcano (Italy)
observations.description: The Sezione di Catania - Osservatorio Etneo (INGV) reported that eruptive activity at Etna?s summit craters during 14-20 September was characterized by gas emissions and periodic minor ash emissions at Northeast Crater and Bocca Nuova Crater, and Strombolian activity at Bocca Nuova. Nearly continuous ash emissions at Northeast Crater were visible during 14-15 September and again during the day on 16 September. The BN1 vent in Bocca Nuova Crater produced Strombolian activity during 15-16 September. Continuous ash emissions rose from the same vent starting on the afternoon of 16 September and stopping at dawn on 18 September. Sporadic diffuse ash emissions at both Northeast and Bocca Nuova craters were visible during 19-20 September. The volcano Alert Level remained at Yellow (the second lowest level on a four-level scale) according to the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile. Sources: Dipartimento della Protezione Civile,Sezione di Catania - Osservatorio Etneo (INGV)
